summary: HiTek Global Inc. filed a Form 6-K announcing a 1-for-25 reverse stock split of its Class A ordinary shares, effective July 6, 2026, to regain or maintain Nasdaq compliance. The split follows prior 1-for-50 and 1-for-3 splits authorized by shareholders in November 2025. Post-split, Class A shares will decrease from ~19.996M to ~800k, with fractional shares rounded up. The board approved the split on June 4, 2026, and filed resolutions with the Cayman Islands Registrar. This is a routine corporate action to meet listing standards, not a special situation. There is no change of control, tender, or strategic event.
